brief:
Pro-Israel advocacy organizations are channeling significant funding into Republican campaigns ahead of the 2024 congressional elections, according to the Quincy Institute. The groups are deploying money and grassroots mobilization to bolster GOP efforts to maintain control of the House and Senate through coordinated financial support and voter engagement activities across key districts and states.

The spending reflects broader efforts by pro-Israel donors to align with Republican candidates on Middle East policy and related legislative priorities. The organizations have prioritized races where Israel-related issues could influence electoral outcomes and where Republican incumbents face competitive challenges from Democratic opponents. Major pro-Israel groups have historically favored Republican support for Israeli government positions on regional security matters and Palestinian policy.
title: Pro-Israel groups spend millions to help Republicans retain Congress
